title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ryman Auditorium, Nashville | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, on 7 July 2012.

It was the 18th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

During the concert the audience sang ‘Happy Birthday To You’ to Starr, who was celebrating his 72nd birthday. Joining the All-Starr Band on this date was Joe Walsh, who sang ‘Rocky Mountain Way’.

Starr returned to the Ryman Auditorium on 18 and 19 June 2016, 7 and 8 August 2019, 24 September 2023, and 14 and 15 January 2025.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
